battery-sofar-sounds:lever:f9532c4c-6b50.description: While this role is hybrid, candidates must be based in the designated city. About Us Born in a London flat in 2009, Sofar began as an answer to a growing problem: live music had lost its magic. It blossomed into a global movement that kept music at its heart while expanding to comedy, singles, dance, and more — all connected by Sofar's renowned track record for discovering rising talent. Countless mainstage performers like Billie Eilish, Jack Harlow, Chappell Roan, Leon Bridges, Olivia Dean, YEBBA, Teddy Swims, Remi Wolf, Hozier, and Lola Young have played Sofar shows early in their careers. More than just a gig, Sofar empowers artists by providing a professional platform that spans both the physical and digital worlds, handling everything from booking and promotion to filling the room, while granting artists access to an ecosystem of opportunities including brand partnerships, a powerful content engine, and global media placements. No two Sofar shows are the same, but each pairs world-class live experience with beautiful and unique spaces — from a ski jump, cave, boat, or hidden museum room, to private living rooms, gardens, and rooftops. Regardless of the setting, each Sofar experience is an invitation to be truly present. Audiences fully immerse themselves in the performance, using their devices not as an escape, but as a tool to support the artist and stay connected to the community. Those of us who work at Sofar are deeply passionate about what we do. Producers are resourceful, proactive, and driven; whether it’s figuring out how to creatively sell tickets or dealing with a live event curveball, they know how to get things done and thrive on the challenge. bvp-auterion:greenhouse:8556696002.description: At Auterion, we build the future of drones and autonomous robots. Our Munich-based production and flight test team is responsible for getting world-class multicopters into the hands of our enterprise and government customers — at scale, on schedule, and with uncompromising quality. As a Flight Test Pilot, you are the final gatekeeper before our multicopters leave the factory. Your hands-on piloting skill, mechanical aptitude, and procedural discipline will directly shape the customer experience of our products. Execute Logistic Preparations for Flight Test Campaigns: Manage the hands-on logistics for occasional off-site test campaigns, including packing equipment, arranging transportation, and setting up remote operational sites to ensure campaign success. Influence Product Quality: Act as a critical feedback source between production and engineering, translating patterns observed in acceptance testing into actionable recommendations for design, process, and quality improvements. Qualifications and Skills: This role demands a blend of piloting precision, mechanical craftsmanship, and methodical rigor — qualities that drive product excellence and align with our core values: Be Bold, Own the Outcome, and Team Over Players.
